crossRefs.note: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
“How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
“However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
“Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said…
Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to…
Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
“I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

translations.web: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
translations.bsb: “Listen carefully to my words; let this be your consolation to me.
translations.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
translations.asv: Hear diligently my speech; And let this be your consolations.
